settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard US shipping arrives in 3–7 business days from our Grand Rapids, Michigan fulfillment center. We process orders Monday–Friday and ship within 1–2 business days of order confirmation. You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — standard shipping is free on all US orders over $60. Orders under $60 ship for a flat $5.95.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship within the United States only. We're working on expanding internationally — sign up to our email list to be the first to know.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy with your purchase, contact us at support@p-nice.com within 30 days of delivery and we'll arrange a full refund or replacement. Products should be at least 50% full; we cover return shipping in the US. See our full Refund Policy for details.

settings.question: Are your products vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. All P-nice products are formulated and tested without animal testing of any kind. Our Retinol and Peptide Face Serum is vegan; our Sleep Plus Collagen Cream contains marine-sourced collagen and is not vegan. Full ingredient lists are on every product page.

settings.question: Where are your products made?
settings.answer: All P-nice products are formulated and manufactured in the United States in FDA-registered cosmetics facilities. Final fulfillment is from our Grand Rapids, Michigan warehouse.

settings.question: Can I use retinol if I have sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Our Retinol and Peptide Face Serum is formulated with bisabolol and phospholipids to be gentler than many retinol products, but everyone's skin is different. We recommend a patch test on your inner forearm 24 hours before first use, and starting with 2–3 nights per week. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Pregnant or nursing? Please consult a healthcare professional before use.

settings.question: When should I apply each product?
settings.answer: Both products are designed for evening use as part of your PM routine. After cleansing: apply Retinol and Peptide Face Serum first, wait 1–2 minutes, then layer Sleep Plus Collagen Cream on top. Use a broad-spectrum SPF every morning.

settings.question: How do I store my products?
settings.answer: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Both products are shelf-stable for 12 months after opening. Refrigeration is not required.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. All payments are processed securely through Stripe and Shopify Payments.

settings.question: How do I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Email us at support@p-nice.com or call 616-520-1895 (Mon–Fri, 9 am–5 pm ET). We aim to respond to all emails within one business day.
